usage.title: Usage
usage.notMounted: No running pod mounts this claim, so nothing measures its usage.
usage.fromKubelet: Measured by the kubelets, refreshed every minute.
usage.kubeletForbidden: You may not read the kubelets' stats (nodes/proxy), so Prometheus is used.
usage.nodesFailed_one: {{count}} node did not answer: the claims mounted there are missing.
usage.nodesFailed_other: {{count}} nodes did not answer: the claims mounted there are missing.
usage.truncated: The cluster is too large: only part of the claims is measured.

thresholds.title: Volume usage
thresholds.warn: Almost full from this percent used
thresholds.critical: Critically full from this percent used
thresholds.hint: Space and inodes of a PersistentVolumeClaim count the same. Used by the Usage colours and by the problems category “Disk almost full”, which is off until you turn it on.
